theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ν μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (x : Euclidean N) (ρ₀ Λ A t : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < ρ₀ → ν (closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * μ (closedBall x r)) → Continuous φ → Antitone φ → (∀ s : ℝ, s ≤ 1 → φ s = 1) → (∀ s : ℝ, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → 0 < A → 0 < t → t * A < ρ₀ → ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2)) ∂ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ * ∫⁻ y, ENNReal.ofReal (φ (‖y - x‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2)) ∂μ
